newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Blue chips push Czech PX50 higher again.
newsitem.headline: Blue chips push Czech PX50 higher again.

text.p: 1400 GMT - The Czech PX50 closes higher in thin trading led by blue chips on Tuesday.
* Overall on bourse, 189 shares rise, 159 fall, 84 unchanged. Turnover 810 million crowns. Volume 736,865 shares.
Czech stocks, led by major issues, continued to surge on Tuesday but analysts said it was too early to predict a sustained recovery.
The PX50 rose 2,2 percent to 520.5 while the blue-chip dominated RPIX gained 3.43 percent, to 1,085.5.
"The stock market was falling for quite a long term and it was time for a correction," said Pavel Sobisek of Zivnostenska Banka.
"I don't think that too many foreign investors are buying Czech stocks at the moment and if they are it's probably because of record highs in the world markets," he added.
